spec.situation_desc: had a mortgage payment taken on the wrong date
spec.vuln_cue: mentions they're caring for their mum full time

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Hello, Sam at Thistle Bank. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Femi Thornbury. My mortgage payment’s come out on the wrong date, and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can look into it. Before we discuss the account, can you confirm your full name and date of birth?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. I can see a payment of £1,246 was taken on the 18th, not the 25th. Is that the one?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes. It’s caused problems with my bills. I’m caring for my mum full time as well, so I’ve got enough to deal with.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. What date did you expect it to come out?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: The 25th. That’s what I’ve always had it set to.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m logging this as a complaint about the payment date. The reference is TB-684219.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. I want to know why it happened.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll take ownership. I’ll review the payment history and send the details to our complaints team by tomorrow, 25 October.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The complaints team will investigate and send you a full written response within 8 weeks. I can’t say what the outcome will be.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: So I’ll review the history and pass it on by tomorrow, and you’ll get the full written response within 8 weeks. Does that make sense?
